About EY
EY is a global leader operating in over 150 countries, delivering exceptional services in Consulting and helping clients transform and enhance their capabilities. We are committed to building a better working world by creating long-term value for clients, people, and society, while fostering trust in capital markets.
This commitment is reflected in a culture that emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and flexibility—empowering you to make a real impact. At EY, your career is yours to shape, supported by a global network, an inclusive culture, and advanced technology. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to bring your ideas to help us grow even further.
The Opportunity
As an AI Software Engineer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and delivering AI-enabled applications for our clients. You will take full ownership of solutions from development through production, working across the full software lifecycle. This role sits in a high-growth area with strong visibility and exposure to cutting-edge AI and engineering practices.
Your Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain full-stack applications using React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Python (FastAPI)
Take end-to-end ownership of application delivery, from design and development to deployment and production support
Design and build scalable backend services and APIs
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into business applications
Apply strong DevOps practices , including CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployment, monitoring, and automation
Actively use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to improve productivity and code quality
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Strong experience in full-stack software development
Hands-on expertise with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Python/FastAPI
Proven experience managing applications across the full software development lifecycle
Strong understanding of DevOps principles and cloud-native development
Experience using AI coding tools in daily development workflows
Excellent problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset
What We Look For
We are looking for passionate engineers who are curious, adaptable, and excited about building AI-driven solutions. If you enjoy taking ownership, working with modern technology, and helping organizations transform through AI, this role is for you.
What We Offer
Continuous Learning: Develop future-ready skills through ongoing training and real-world experience
Success as Defined by You: Flexibility and tools to make a meaningful impact in your own way
Transformative Leadership: Coaching and support to help you grow as a leader
Diverse & Inclusive Culture: An environment where your individuality is valued and your voice is heard

The Software Engineering Director for AI Tooling plays a pivotal role in translating strategy into execution—designing and scaling modern software platforms, AIenabled tools, and internal products that create measurable value for Fortune 500 and growthstage clients alike.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering excellence, applied AI, and business impact—partnering closely with executives, product leaders, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver systems that can be adopted, trusted, and scaled.
Your key responsibilities
As a Software Engineering Director, you will lead the design and delivery of productiongrade software systems and AIenabled tooling that underpin highvisibility client engagements and internal platforms. You will own architectural decisions, development standards, and technical direction across multiple workstreams.
Key responsibilities include:
Architect, build, and scale core software platforms that integrate data, AI services, and userfacing applications.
Lead the development of AIpowered tools, including decision support systems, copilots, internal developer tools, and domainspecific agents.
Design and maintain robust service architectures (APIs, eventdriven systems, batch and realtime pipelines) optimized for reliability, security, and extensibility.
Establish engineering best practices across code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to productionize models and agents, ensuring seamless integration into realworld workflows.
Partner directly with business leaders and Csuite executives to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Successful candidates will bring strong engineering judgment, fluency in modern AI tooling, and the ability to operate comfortably across strategy and execution.
You will be expected to:
Lead development of backend and fullstack systems using modern languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, TypeScript).
Design and manage cloudnative architectures on platforms such as AWS or GCP, using containerization and infrastructureascode.
Build AIready application layers that integrate LLMs, retrieval systems, vector databases, and model orchestration frameworks.
Develop internal tooling and developer platforms that improve velocity, reliability, and reuse across teams.
Define and enforce standards for security, privacy, reliability, and compliance (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA, enterprise governance).
Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete system designs and incremental delivery plans.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 5+ years of professional engineering experience; or A graduate degree and approximately 3+ years of relevant experience.
D emonstrated experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering, or technical leadership roles.
Strong proficiency in modern software development practices, including APIs, distributed systems, and cloud services.
Hands on experience deploying AIenabled applications or tooling into production environments.
Comfort operating in fastpaced, clientfacing environments with evolving requirements.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
Experience working in management consulting, productled organizations, or highgrowth startups.
Familiarity with modern AI ecosystems, including LLM frameworks, agent architectures, and prompt/tool orchestration.
A strong product mindset—understanding not just how to build systems, but how they will be adopted and sustained.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
What we look for
We are looking for candidates who have a strong aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients’ goals.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more .
We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $205,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable bridging two worlds: business users (clients), with a focus on ROI and deliverables; and engineers, who are seeking mentorship and prioritize building new technical skills.
As a Manager in Application Systems Engineering, you will be at the forefront of defining user and customer requirements, focusing on development across diverse platforms. You'll play a pivotal role in engineering software components and services that ensure seamless communication within the system architecture.
Your key responsibilities
As a vital member of our team, you will manage and deliver high-quality processes, solutions, or projects, with a strong focus on quality, risk management, and continuous improvement. Establishing and driving software engineering best practices and set standards across our global blockchain team

You’re an innovator. You keep up to date on emerging technologies (especially blockchain) and are constantly thinking about potential applications.
You’re a people developer. You find and cultivate talent to achieve outstanding results. You give your team creative freedom to innovate while holding them accountable for making good decisions and delivering results.
You’re focused on customer value. You don’t blindly implement specs and actively talk to customers and stakeholders to design solutions to their problems.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You thrive in the face of complex problems with no obvious solutions.
You’re entrepreneurial at heart. You have a passion for making your ideas a reality, building prototypes and ultimately launching production-scale solutions in the market.
Agile development methodologies.
Application integration and quality assurance.
Proficiency in software development and technology business requirements analysis.
Strong relationship management and negotiation skills.

A bachelor's degree is required, with at least 4-6 years of relevant experience.
5+ years of professional engineering experience with 3+ years of people management experience
Hands-on experience with modern full-stack JavaScript development including Node.js and frameworks such as React and Express
Experience designing and implementing RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs
Experience building cloud native/microservices architecture applications and platforms
Experience with Agile software development (like Scrum or Kanban)
Knowledge of professional software engineering practices and the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Proven experience in project management of complex deliverables
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Willingness and ability to travel to meet client needs
Ideally, you’ll also have
Passion for blockchain technology and experience with Ethereum, Quorum, and/or Solidity
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Previous experience deploying and configuring environments using infrastructure-as-code provisioning tools like Terraform and Ansible
Experience with traditional enterprise technologies including SaaS and ERP systems (like SAP)
Experience managing customer-facing engineering teams
Experience with another language in addition to JavaScript/Typescript for example Rust, Golang, Python, or Java.
Interest in the emerging field of AI, including experience with:
Large Language Models and integration with those
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
EmbeddingsStrong analytical and decision-making capabilities.

Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Senior Consultant DevSecOps, Platform & Software Engineering entwickelst du moderne, Cloud-native und KI-gestützte Anwendungen und Plattformen für große Industrieunternehmen und den öffentlichen Sektor. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
Du entwickelst Cloud-native Backend- und Fullstack-Anwendungen mit Java/Spring, .NET, TypeScript oder Python bis zum produktiven Betrieb.
Du entwickelst und betreibst Cloud-, Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Plattformen und automatisierst Infrastruktur und Deployments mit IaC und CI/CD.
Du integrierst LLMs, RAG-Architekturen und agentische Systeme in Anwendungen und nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungsmethoden im Engineering-Alltag.
Du integrierst Supply-Chain-Security, automatisierte Tests und sichere Entwicklungsstandards in Build-, Deployment- und Betriebsprozesse.
Du übernimmst Mentoring und Reviews, arbeitest eng mit Kund:innen zusammen und entwickelst unsere Software-Engineering-Angebote weiter.

Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung Cloud-nativer Anwendungen. Erste Team-Lead Erfahrung gesammelt zu haben ist wünschenswert.
Du bringst Backend- oder Fullstack-Expertise sowie Erfahrung mit Microservices, Containern, Cloud- oder Kubernetes-Plattformen, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, Testing und DevSecOps mit.

Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.

Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. About the Role
We are seeking a Senior Manager, Application Security & AI Engineering to lead the design, implementation, and transformation of secure software development and AI-enabled applications. This role will drive Secure-by-Design practices, enterprise threat modeling, DevSecOps, AI security, and GenAI governance across cloud-native and digital platforms. The role is grounded in how developers work today: in AI-assisted IDEs and agentic coding workflows, where security must be a native part of the authoring experience rather than a downstream gate.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute Application Security and AI Security strategy, architecture standards, and transformation roadmaps.
Lead Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps initiatives across product and engineering organizations.
Govern the use of AI coding assistants and autonomous coding agents across the SSDLC, defining sandboxing, credential scoping, tool-access boundaries, and review standards for AI-authored code.
Shift security review in-line to the point of authorship, embedding automated and AI-assisted review in the IDE and in pull requests so developers receive high-confidence, fix-ready feedback as they write code.
Address the risks introduced by AI-generated and prompt-driven development, including code provenance, hallucinated or typosquatted dependencies, and prompt injection reaching agents that hold repository or pipeline access.
Establish and scale threat modeling programs using STRIDE, PASTA, MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, attack trees, and abuse cases.
Conduct security architecture reviews and risk assessments for applications, APIs, microservices, cloud services, and AI solutions.
Design and oversee SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis, API Security, Container Security, and Cloud Security capabilities.
Architect secure AI and GenAI solutions, including LLM applications, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation platforms, and agentic AI systems.
Develop controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, model access, prompt security, data protection, guardrails, and responsible AI governance.
Partner with engineering, product, cloud, data, and cyber teams to embed security throughout the development lifecycle.
Mentor application security architects, AI engineers, DevSecOps professionals, and security consultants.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of experience in application security, software engineering, cloud security, AI engineering, or cybersecurity.
Deep expertise in secure application architecture, threat modeling, vulnerability management, attack-path analysis, and Secure-by-Design principles.
Experience leading enterprise-scale Application Security, DevSecOps, or secure engineering transformation programs.
Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, containers, and AI/GenAI technologies.
Current, hands-on experience building software with agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot, including how to configure and secure them for enterprise use.
Excellent leadership, executive communication, client-facing, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred Skills & Technologies
Threat Modeling: STRIDE, PASTA, MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS , threat-modeling-as-code, and automated threat modeling integrated into the delivery pipeline.
Application Security: Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, reachability-based software composition analysis, Burp Suite, and the OWASP Top 10 for web, API, and LLM applications.
Cloud & DevSecOps: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Azure DevOps, with policy-as-code enforcement using OPA or Kyverno.
AI & GenAI: Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, and the Model Context Protocol.
AI-Assisted Development: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex, including agent rules and context files, Model Context Protocol tooling, agent sandboxing, and in-line security review workflows.
AI Security: AI threat modeling, red teaming, prompt-injection testing, RAG security, agent security, model risk, guardrails, and responsible AI governance.
Preferred Certifications
CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, CISM, GWAPT, CKS, and relevant Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, AI Security, or Responsible AI certifications.
What You'll Bring
A passion for building secure digital products and AI-powered solutions. You will help organizations reduce risk, accelerate innovation, and enable trusted AI adoption through strong threat modeling, secure engineering practices, and modern application security capabilities.
Differentiator: Day-to-day, hands-on experience with agentic development tools, particularly Cursor and Claude Code alongside with experience leading enterprise Secure AI SDLC, AI Red Teaming, and AI Governance programs.

Bay Area California offices – $193,500 to $401,600
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $154,700 to $353,500
Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Translating AI strategy into a implementable Model Engineering activities that aligns with the client’s goals, mission and vision

Applying a product-centric development approach to data and AI solutions by defining user outcomes, prioritizing reusable capabilities, managing roadmaps and backlogs, incorporating user feedback, measuring adoption and business value, and continuously improving products after launch
Staying abreast of AI technology trends and provide directional guidance and recommendations around AIOps, MLOps, and AgentOps tools and solutions on Databricks that fit their needs and integrate with their existing ecosystem
Applying combined business and technical knowledge to develop and execute ModelOps target architecture on Databricks that enables implementation and monitoring of AI at scale, with tools like Unity Catalog and Model Serving
Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Platform Engineers, DevOps to implement and sustain solutions in the Databricks platform
Understanding clients’ overall data, AI and technology landscape and business priorities and success measures
Strong team collaboration and experience working with a diverse team in a hybrid model (on site and remote)
Working on large-scale client engagements. Fostering relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently delivering quality client services. Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
Collaborating, influencing and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making

A Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree).
3-6 years of full-time working experience in AI and/or Machine Learning
Databricks Certification with a minimum of 1 professional and 1 associate certification that includes a combination of Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Strong skills in Python, PySpark, and/or Scala
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with diverse, hybrid, and global teams.
Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-impact, high-value production AI/ML solutions on a major cloud platform using Databricks
At least two years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions on Databricks, including experience with Agent Bricks, Model Serving, or Lakeflow Jobs.
Delivered models or agents to production on Databricks, with tracking, evaluation, and monitoring.
Proficient in foundation models, generative AI, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)) and experienced with ML packages like scikit-learn and PyTorch, using Databricks tools including Agent Bricks, AI Search, Foundation Model APIs, and Unity Gateway
Experience with natural language processing and deep learning
Extensive experience in DevOps tools (Git, Azure DevOps) and AI-driven SDLC for developing, deploying, and scaling analytical solutions on Databricks, for example with Databricks Git folders, Declarative Automation Bundles, and the Databricks CLI and SDKs
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps and ML workflows on Databricks, including data ingestion, transformation, and evaluation, for example with MLflow, Models in Unity Catalog, and Model Serving
Experience with model retraining and feedback loop methodologies on Databricks, for example with Lakeflow Jobs and Databricks Feature Store
Experience evaluating and operating models and AI solutions on Databricks, including observability, monitoring, reporting, MLflow evaluation and tracing, and data quality monitoring.
Understanding of data structures, Responsible AI practices, and data modelling, and software engineering best practices
Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and operations research, with proficiency in data manipulation tools (SQL, Pandas, Spark) and deep learning techniques, using Databricks tools such as Databricks SQL and Delta Lake, using Databricks tools such as Databricks SQL and Delta Lake.
Excellent communication skills for conveying findings and recommendations, with willingness to travel as needed for client engagements.

Experience in hybrid collaboration and emotional agility
A track record of working with diverse teams to drive outcomes through complex problem-solving of working with diverse teams to drive outcomes through complex problem-solving

A deep understanding of and ability to teach concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches to apply them
Experience fine-tuning Generative AI models on Databricks, including with AI Runtime (serverless GPU)
Experience with image processing techniques and/or speech and audio processing and analysis

Advanced certifications in AI, Data Science, Cloud AI, or Enterprise Architecture.

Managing multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex AI engineering initiatives, with accountability for quality, responsible deployment, and results
Engaging actively with clients, participating in daily working sessions, and leading workstreams from planning through execution to closure
Designing, building, and governing domain ontologies and semantic models that define business concepts, relationships, and rules for AI solutions, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data products
Applying a product-centric development approach by partnering with product, business, data science, and engineering stakeholders to define user needs, prioritize reusable capabilities, and iteratively deliver measurable outcomes across the product lifecycle
Identifying opportunities for additional services and managing engagement economics

To excel in this role, you will need a blend of technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. This role will work to deliver tech at speed, innovate at scale and put humans at the center. Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with team members with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services focusing on more complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues surrounding emerging technology. Demonstrate technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Learn about EY and its service lines and actively assess and present ways to apply knowledge and services
The following attributes will make a significant impact:
Translating AI strategy into a implementable Model Engineering activities that aligns with the client’s goals, mission and vision
Leading teams of AI engineers, data engineers, and data scientists in the delivery of production-grade solutions for clients on Databricks; These include data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions
Implementing product-centric AI solutions on Databricks, from discovery and roadmap definition through iterative delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable business and user outcomes.
Working across design, build, deploy, and operate phases to deliver production-grade data and AI pipelines, governed business ontologies, and semantic models on Databricks, ensuring solutions are reliable, reusable, and aligned with client business processes
Experience applying a product-centric development approach to data and AI solutions by defining user outcomes, prioritizing reusable capabilities, managing roadmaps and backlogs, incorporating user feedback, measuring adoption and business value, and continuously improving products after launch
Staying abreast of AI technology trends and provide directional guidance and recommendations around AIOps, MLOps, and AgentOps tools and solutions on Databricks that fit their needs and integrate with their existing ecosystem
Applying combined business and technical knowledge to develop and execute ModelOps target architecture on Databricks that enables implementation and monitoring of AI at scale, with tools like Unity Catalog and Model Serving
Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Platform Engineers, DevOps to implement and sustain solutions in the Databricks platform
Staying abreast of industry trends, technology innovations and AI regulatory requirements across the globe
Understanding clients’ overall data, AI and technology landscape and business priorities and success measures
Strong team collaboration and experience working with a diverse team in a hybrid model (on site and remote)
Fostering relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels
Consistently delivering quality client services
Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
Collaborating, influencing and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making

A Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree)
6-10 years of relevant experience of full-time working experience in AI, Data Science, and/or Machine Learning
2-4 years of experience directly managing technical teams
3-4 years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions on the Databricks platform, including use of Agent Bricks, Model Serving, or Lakeflow Jobs
Databricks Certification with a minimum of 1 professional and 1 associate certification that includes a combination of Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Strong skills in Python, PySpark, and/or Scala
Ability lead, collaborate, and communicate effectively with diverse, hybrid and global teams
Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-impact, high-value production AI/ML solutions on a major cloud platform, using Databricks
Delivered models or agents to production on Databricks, with tracking, evaluation, and monitoring

Full time employment, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30 am – 5:30 pm.

- SQL and NoSQL;

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
As AI Engineer, you will design and build production-grade AI and agentic AI solutions that solve real business problems for EY's clients. You are the core builder on the delivery team, responsible for AI/ML pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-agent coordination, evaluation frameworks, observability and governance that ensure AI solutions work in production.
The opportunity
You will work across complex client engagements designing and implementing AI/ML and agentic AI solutions end to end. You will work closely with business stakeholders, AI Architect, AI Platform Engineers, and Data Scientists to translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and responsible AI solutions through maintainable architectural. You will have the opportunity to influence executive stakeholders and help clients responsibly adopt agentic AI to drive measurable business outcomes.
This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.
Your key responsibilities
Design and implement production-grade agentic AI workflows using open frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, proprietary cloud-based agentic platforms, including agent orchestration, AI gateways (i.e. MCP, A2A), observability, controls and guardrails.
Build and optimise retrieval pipelines for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows, including chunking strategies, embedding models, vector store integration, and re-ranking to ground agent outputs in accurate, current enterprise data.
Develop and integrate Generative/Agentic AI solutions using large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs).
Build evaluation frameworks to measure AI solution quality, consistency, and implement telemetry and monitoring to track model drift, latency, output quality, and cost metrics in production.
Leverage machine learning/deep learning algorithms and foundational statistical concepts to solve real-world AI/ML problems at scale
Implement best practices for MLOps, LLMOps, across experimental and production environments, including AI pipeline and microservices deployment into cloud environments, APIs, CI/CD, ensuring high availability and low latency.
Build AI governance and responsible AI controls for AI systems
Mentor junior team members and contribute to EY AI assets, accelerators, delivery standards, and go-to-market offerings in AI/ML, agentic and generative AI
Skills and attributes for success
Deep experience designing and building agentic AI systems in enterprise environments.
Analytical mindset to troubleshoot AI-specific failure modes, model hallucinations, retrieval gaps, context overflow, agent looping, and system latency and engineer reliable solutions around them.
Experience with AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory considerations in complex or regulated industries.
Adapts quickly to fast-moving environments with frequent updates in AI frameworks, agentic tool patterns, LLM capabilities, and cloud platform services
To qualify for the role, you must have
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or related technical discipline (MSc/PhD is an advantage).
3-8+ years of AI development experience, with at least 2 years focused on building and maintaining production grade AI/ML or agentic AI solutions.
Hands-on experience in developing machine learning and deep learning algorithms at scale
Deep experience working with AI/ML libraries and frameworks
Understanding of foundational statistics and mathematical modeling
Advanced object-oriented coding skills in Python for production-level codebases. Familiarity with Java, TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus.
Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents and AI/ML solutions.
Hands-on experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and version control for AI systems; working knowledge of LLM observability and monitoring tools.
Experience in API integration and development.
Consulting or professional services experience is strongly preferred.
What we look for
We’re interested in passionate leaders with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the IT Advisory space. If you have a strong passion for helping businesses achieve their IT strategy, this role is for you.
What we offer
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 15 days of vacation plus ten observed holidays and three paid personal days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:
The opportunity to manage a portfolio of talent within a designated service line
A collaborative environment where everyone works together to create a better working world
Excellent training and development prospects, both through established programs and on-the-job training
An excellent team of senior colleagues, dedicated to managing and varying your workload
EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.
Salary Ranges: $88,000 – $132,000
Inclusiveness at EY
Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.
Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with the highest ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

Job Description
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
Role Details
Key responsibilities include :
Scientific formulation and advanced modelling
Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.
Upstream applications
Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.
Downstream applications
Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.
Model assurance and generalization
Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.
Technical leadership and scalable delivery
Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
At EY, you will have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by our global scale, inclusive culture and technology ecosystem. We value your perspective and count on your ideas to help us build a better working world.
Financial institutions are modernizing how they manage anti-money laundering, sanctions, fraud and broader financial crime risk. This transformation increasingly depends on trusted data, scalable cloud platforms, advanced analytics and responsibly governed artificial intelligence. Our teams help clients turn these capabilities into practical, explainable and sustainable solutions.
At EY, Data Engineers strive to implement innovative approaches to maximize harvests of strategic information, solving many of our clients’ biggest challenges. We are working to integrate this capability into our full range of Consulting service offerings and help clients leverage data as an asset across all their business processes.
The opportunity
Our Canada Financial Crime group is seeking a Staff Consultant in Data Engineering. You will work with multidisciplinary teams to design and implement data solutions that improve how clients detect risk, prioritize alerts, support investigations and meet regulatory obligations.
The role combines hands-on data engineering with consulting. You will help translate business and regulatory needs into reliable data products, analytical pipelines and AI-enabled capabilities, while maintaining strong controls for data quality, privacy, security, explainability and model governance.
The Financial Crime group offers expertise and services across four core areas of competency:
Data Management and Integration: providing the foundational layers for enterprise data accessibility, covering data sourcing and integration, data warehouse and modeling, master data management, and data rationalisation and migration.
Data Quality and Governance: developing an organisation that treats data as a critical enterprise asset and sources quality data for business use and regulatory compliance. This includes examining the fitness for purpose of data for specific business needs, data remediation, and the strategy, roles, policies and processes to effectively manage data through its lifecycle.
Reporting and solution architecture: This includes the end-to-end reporting lifecycle across advisory and strategy, identifying compliance reporting trouble spots and delivering achievable roadmaps, design and implementation.
Analytics and AI: covers operational analytics, predictive analytics, industry models and analytics enablement, and provides actionable enterprise insight and delivers value from an enterprises data. This also includes several generative AI use cases, model monitoring and responsible AI practices that deliver actionable insight.
Your responsibilities
As a Staff Consultant, you will support the delivery of priority client engagements, build trusted relationships and continue developing your technical and consulting capabilities.
We succeed when we combine high performing team members from a variety of backgrounds. We will provide the required support to transition into the team if this is your first step into consultancy.
Specifically, your responsibilities will include:
Participate in client workshops, solution design sessions, delivery planning and internal practice-development initiatives.
Analyze, profile, structure, validate and transform large, complex and sensitive data sets from multiple sources.Produce and document analyses of various data sources
Design, build and document scalable batch and streaming data pipelines, data models and APIs for financial crime use cases.
Implement data-quality checks, reconciliation controls, lineage and monitoring to support reliable and auditable outcomes.
Work with data scientists and business specialists to operationalize analytics and machine-learning models, including feature pipelines, model inputs, outputs and monitoring.
Evaluate and help implement AI-enabled capabilities, including generative AI and large language model use cases for investigation support, summarization, knowledge retrieval and workflow automation.
Apply responsible AI principles, including human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias testing, traceability and appropriate use of client data.
Produce clear technical documentation and communicate findings, risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Skills & attributes for success
Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering or a related role.
Established problem-solving skills and sound judgment when working with incomplete, complex or sensitive information.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business and regulatory stakeholders. (French and English)
Strong client-service mindset and the ability to build effective relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work independently in large organizations, particularly financial institutions, while collaborating effectively with delivery teams.
Curiosity, rigor, adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning.
To qualify for the role you must have:
A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, data science, information systems, operations research or a related field. A master’s degree is an asset.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, including experience writing maintainable, tested and reusable code. Experience with another object-oriented language is an asset.
Experience building ETL or ELT pipelines and working with large data sets using technologies such as Spark, Databricks or equivalent distributed-processing platforms.
Experience with data modelling, data quality, orchestration and workflow tools, and source-control practices such as Git.
Working knowledge of cloud data services in Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
Ability to use AI-assisted development tools as a force multiplier for programming tasks, including code generation, debugging, testing and documentation, while critically validating outputs and maintaining code quality, security and confidentiality.
Foundational knowledge of machine learning and AI concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model lifecycle, generative AI and large language models.
Awareness of AI risks and controls, including explainability, privacy, security, hallucination risk, prompt injection, bias, data leakage and human-in-the-loop review.
Demonstrated technical problem-solving skills and the ability to work across data, applications, infrastructure and security teams.
Professional proficiency in English. French-language capabilities are an asset for serving clients in Québec and across Canada.Knowledge of French and English (bilingual)
Ideally, you’ll also have:
Experience in AML, sanctions, fraud, KYC, transaction monitoring, investigations or financial crime risk management.
Experience with financial crime platforms such as NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM or Mantas, Firco Continuity, Alessa or comparable solutions.
Experience with SAS or SAS Viya, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory or similar data and orchestration tools.
Experience deploying or integrating machine-learning models, MLOps pipelines, feature stores, model registries or monitoring solutions.
Hands-on exposure to generative AI patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, prompt design, evaluation frameworks, guardrails or agentic workflows.
Knowledge of responsible AI or model-risk-management frameworks and their application in regulated financial institutions.
Experience in business intelligence, solution architecture, cybersecurity, systems analysis or business analysis.
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience.
What we look for
We are looking for motivated professionals who combine technical depth with practical judgment. You are comfortable taking initiative, learning new technologies and working through ambiguity, while remaining focused on quality, trust and client outcomes. You bring a collaborative mindset and an interest in helping clients solve complex financial crime challenges responsibly.
What we offer

Our Canada Financial Crime group is seeking a Senior Consultant in Data Engineering. You will work with multidisciplinary teams to design and implement data solutions that improve how clients detect risk, prioritize alerts, support investigations and meet regulatory obligations.
The role combines hands-on data engineering with consulting. You will help translate business and regulatory needs into reliable data products, analytical pipelines and AI-enabled capabilities, while maintaining strong controls for data quality, privacy, security, explainability and model governance.
The Financial Crime group offers expertise and services across four core areas of competency:
Data Management and Integration: providing the foundational layers for enterprise data accessibility, covering data sourcing and integration, data warehouse and modeling, master data management, and data rationalisation and migration.
Data Quality and Governance: developing an organisation that treats data as a critical enterprise asset and sources quality data for business use and regulatory compliance. This includes examining the fitness for purpose of data for specific business needs, data remediation, and the strategy, roles, policies and processes to effectively manage data through its lifecycle.
Reporting and solution architecture: This includes the end-to-end reporting lifecycle across advisory and strategy, identifying compliance reporting trouble spots and delivering achievable roadmaps, design and implementation.
Analytics and AI: covers operational analytics, predictive analytics, industry models and analytics enablement, and provides actionable enterprise insight and delivers value from an enterprises data. This also includes several generative AI use cases, model monitoring and responsible AI practices that deliver actionable insight.
Your responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant, you will support the delivery of priority client engagements, build trusted relationships and continue developing your technical and consulting capabilities.
We succeed when we combine high performing team members from a variety of backgrounds. We will provide the required support to transition into the team if this is your first step into consultancy.

Participate in client workshops, solution design sessions, delivery planning and internal practice-development initiatives.
Analyze, profile, structure, validate and transform large, complex and sensitive data sets from multiple sources.Produce and document analyses of various data sources
Design, build and document scalable batch and streaming data pipelines, data models and APIs for financial crime use cases.
Implement data-quality checks, reconciliation controls, lineage and monitoring to support reliable and auditable outcomes.
Work with data scientists and business specialists to operationalize analytics and machine-learning models, including feature pipelines, model inputs, outputs and monitoring.
Evaluate and help implement AI-enabled capabilities, including generative AI and large language model use cases for investigation support, summarization, knowledge retrieval and workflow automation.
Apply responsible AI principles, including human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias testing, traceability and appropriate use of client data.
Produce clear technical documentation and communicate findings, risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering or a related role.
Established problem-solving skills and sound judgment when working with incomplete, complex or sensitive information.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business and regulatory stakeholders. (French and English)
Strong client-service mindset and the ability to build effective relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work independently in large organizations, particularly financial institutions, while collaborating effectively with delivery teams.
Curiosity, rigor, adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning.

A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, data science, information systems, operations research or a related field. A master’s degree is an asset.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, including experience writing maintainable, tested and reusable code. Experience with another object-oriented language is an asset.
Experience building ETL or ELT pipelines and working with large data sets using technologies such as Spark, Databricks or equivalent distributed-processing platforms.
Experience with data modelling, data quality, orchestration and workflow tools, and source-control practices such as Git.
Working knowledge of cloud data services in Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
Ability to use AI-assisted development tools as a force multiplier for programming tasks, including code generation, debugging, testing and documentation, while critically validating outputs and maintaining code quality, security and confidentiality.
Foundational knowledge of machine learning and AI concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model lifecycle, generative AI and large language models.
Awareness of AI risks and controls, including explainability, privacy, security, hallucination risk, prompt injection, bias, data leakage and human-in-the-loop review.
Demonstrated technical problem-solving skills and the ability to work across data, applications, infrastructure and security teams.
Professional proficiency in English. French-language capabilities are an asset for serving clients in Québec and across Canada.Knowledge of French and English (bilingual)

Experience in AML, sanctions, fraud, KYC, transaction monitoring, investigations or financial crime risk management.
Experience with financial crime platforms such as NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM or Mantas, Firco Continuity, Alessa or comparable solutions.
Experience with SAS or SAS Viya, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory or similar data and orchestration tools.
Experience deploying or integrating machine-learning models, MLOps pipelines, feature stores, model registries or monitoring solutions.
Hands-on exposure to generative AI patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, prompt design, evaluation frameworks, guardrails or agentic workflows.
Knowledge of responsible AI or model-risk-management frameworks and their application in regulated financial institutions.
Experience in business intelligence, solution architecture, cybersecurity, systems analysis or business analysis.
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience.

Continuously improving processes by identifying innovative solutions through research and analysis.

Identifying opportunities for additional services and managing engagement economics.

Working with utility data sources including SCADA, AMI/AMI 2.0, GIS, EAM (e.g., Maximo), OMS, CIS, and historian systems, and integrating these into modern analytics platforms.
Supporting utilities in moving AI solutions from pilots to production while meeting regulatory, audit, cybersecurity, and data governance requirements.

Strong skills in Python

Experience with natural language processing and deep learning

Experience with model retraining and feedback loop methodologies
Experience with model and solution monitoring and reporting
Understanding of data structures, data modelling and software engineering best practices

Excellent communication skills for conveying findings and recommendations, with a willingness to travel for client engagements
Skills in Technical Design Optimization
Strong relationship-building skills
Demonstrated client trust and value
Digital fluency and emotional agility
Commercial acumen and negotiation skills
Proven ability to lead teams and manage change

Familiarity with utility regulatory, compliance, or operational data considerations is a plus.

A deep understanding of and ability to teach concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches to apply them
Master's degree Computer Science, Mathematics, Physical Sciences, or other quantitative field
Experience working with diverse teams to deliver complex solutions
Strong skills in languages beyond Python: R, JavaScript, Java, C++, C
Experience fine-tuning Generative AI models
Experience in managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
A strong understanding of industry trends and emerging technologies
Skills in data visualization and storytelling with data
Experience with image processing techniques and/or speech and audio processing and analysis

Experience supporting executive-level decision-making in regulated environments, including preparation of materials that may be reviewed by regulators or governing bodies.

This role is centered on the implementation, engineering, integration, and administration of enterprise scale data protection and privacy technologies, helping organizations protect sensitive data across endpoints, networks, cloud, applications, and AI enabled platforms.
You will work closely with clients to design and operationalize Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data discovery and classification, privacy management platforms, and privacy enhancing technologies (PETs)—enabling compliant, secure, and trusted use of data in modern digital and AI driven environments.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and engineering of enterprise data protection and privacy platforms, including DLP, data discovery, classification, and privacy tooling.
Implement and administer Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions across endpoint, email, network, cloud, and SaaS environments.
Design and operationalize data discovery and data classification programs, enabling visibility into sensitive data across structured and unstructured sources.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Position Summary
The role will design, develop, test, deploy, and support secure, scalable data solutions that consolidate identity and access data from enterprise source systems into a centralized operational data store. The platform supports access visibility, operational reporting, risk analysis, remediation, automation, and decision-making across.
The engineer will contribute across the data-delivery lifecycle, including source-system discovery, data analysis, dimensional and relational modeling, ETL development, pipeline orchestration, data-quality validation, performance tuning, release automation, and production support. This role requires strong recent hands-on Microsoft SQL Server or Azure SQL engineering experience and the ability to deliver independently within an integrated Agile product team.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain robust data pipelines and database solutions supporting the IAM Operational Data Store and related reporting applications.
Analyze source-system data and translate business, reporting, risk, and control requirements into scalable conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Develop and optimize Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL objects, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, indexing, partitioning, and transformation logic.
Build repeatable ETL and ingestion patterns for identity, account, entitlement, credential, inventory, activity, certification, lifecycle, and control-related data.
Develop and maintain SnapLogic pipelines and supporting scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and loading.
Integrate data from cloud and on-premises sources using databases, APIs, Microsoft Graph, flat files, and other enterprise integration patterns.
Create prepared-layer tables, source-to-target mappings, reusable transformation components, and reporting-ready datasets.
Implement data-quality checks, reconciliation routines, health indicators, exception handling, logging, retry logic, and operational monitoring.
Tune database queries, pipelines, and data models to improve performance, scalability, reliability, and cost effectiveness.
Protect sensitive identity and access data by applying secure database design, least-privilege access, secrets-management, encryption, and data-handling practices.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes supporting controlled promotion across development, quality-assurance, pre-production, and production environments.
Perform unit, integration, regression, data-quality, and production-validation testing for ingestion pipelines and database changes.
Troubleshoot data, application, pipeline, database, API, and deployment issues using logs, query plans, monitoring tools, and reconciliation evidence.
Collaborate with analysts, product owners, architects, data-source owners, reporting engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to define and deliver end-to-end data solutions.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, code and design reviews, release readiness, and continuous-improvement activities.
Create and maintain technical designs, data models, lineage documentation, implementation procedures, test evidence, operational runbooks, and support materials.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, information technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Approximately 6–9 years of enterprise data-engineering, database-development, or related experience.
At least five years of strong SQL development experience, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, indexing, and relational database design.
Recent hands-on development experience within the last three years using Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, or Azure SQL Managed Instance.
Strong understanding of relational and dimensional data modeling, normalization, data warehousing, operational data stores, fact and dimension structures, and slowly changing dimensions.
Experience designing, developing, and supporting ETL pipelines and data-ingestion solutions for high-volume, multi-source enterprise data.
Experience with SnapLogic or a comparable enterprise integration platform.
Proficiency in one or more supporting languages or tools such as Python, PowerShell, Unix shell scripting, or PL/SQL.
Experience with Microsoft Azure data services and cloud-based database solutions.
Experience implementing data-quality checks, source-to-target reconciliation, error handling, logging, monitoring, and operational support processes.
Experience with Git-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment, and tools such as Jenkins and Docker.
Experience testing database changes, transformations, and end-to-end ingestion flows across multiple environments.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently, review existing solutions, identify gaps, and deliver production-ready enhancements with limited ramp-up time.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience delivering data solutions for identity and access management, identity governance, privileged access management, cybersecurity, or technology-risk use cases.
Familiarity with IAM data domains such as identities, accounts, entitlements, applications, credentials, privileged access, certifications, and lifecycle events.
Experience building centralized operational data stores that support reporting, risk analysis, remediation, automation, and audit evidence.
Hands-on experience with SnapLogic, including API, database, file, and cloud integration pipelines.
Experience integrating Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, LDAP or Active Directory data, and structured or semi-structured file sources.
Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, PySpark, Informatica, Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable data technologies.
Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL variants such as YugabyteDB or CockroachDB, Oracle, DB2, and cloud-hosted database inventory or audit data.
Experience creating reporting-ready datasets for Power BI, Tableau, or comparable analytics platforms.
Experience with graph databases or analytics platforms such as Neo4j.
Familiarity with data lineage, metadata management, control reporting, and enterprise data-governance practices.
Experience in a regulated financial-services environment and knowledge of secure software development, change management, and production-readiness controls.
Relevant Microsoft Azure, database, data-engineering, or cybersecurity certifications.

Champion a platform-as-a-product model, including internal developer platforms, golden paths, and developer self-service (e.g., Backstage).
Set standards for automation and GitOps (Helm, Terraform/OpenTofu, Argo CD/Flux, CI/CD), software supply-chain security (signing, SBOMs, policy-as-code), resilience and disaster recovery, and cost optimization.

Lead service mesh adoption (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium) end to end—mesh selection, control-plane design, data-plane architecture decisions, upgrades, gateway strategy, and zero-trust service-to-service security
Pursuits, Delivery & Stakeholder Management:
Manage workstream scope, staffing, and status reporting; define and report platform outcomes such as DORA metrics, SLOs, and cost efficiency.
Establish observability and SRE practices (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), including SLOs, alerting, incident reviews, and reliability improvements.
Shape platform and AI-ready platform solutions in client pursuits, including solution approach, estimates, and SOW inputs; lead working sessions, architecture reviews, and steering updates.

Leading workstream delivery and ensuring quality in all processes.
Engaging with clients on a daily basis, actively participating in working sessions, and identifying opportunities for additional services.
Implementing resource plans and budgets while managing engagement economics.

Manage and mentor a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with clients to understand their analytics needs and deliver tailored solutions that drive business value.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders, including technical and non-technical audiences, to convey complex data concepts and project progress.
Manage client relationships and expectations, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and engagement.
Stay abreast of the latest trends and technologies in data engineering, cloud computing, and analytics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly.
Proven experience in managing and delivering projects effectively.

Typically, no less than 4 - 6 years relevant experience in cloud, platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams or workstreams.
AI-native engineering: hands-on workflow experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools, and leading their adoption across engineering teams.

Cloud: architecture experience across major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), including landing zones, networking, and IAM.

Automation: establishing IaC, CI/CD, and GitOps standards across teams (Terraform, Helm, Argo CD or Flux).
Coding: proficiency in Python, Go, or Java for automation and tooling.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on client management.

Advanced AI/ML engineering certifications such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer—or equivalent hands-on project experience.
Certifications such as CKA, CKS, Istio Certified Associate, HashiCorp Terraform, or AWS/Azure/GCP professional-level.
Multi-cluster service mesh, Envoy extensibility, or API gateways (Kong, Apigee, Azure API Management).
Self-hosted model serving and GPU infrastructure (vLLM, Triton, NIM), AIOps, or hybrid/on-premises platforms (VMware, OpenShift).

Security Technology – Cloud Security Engineer
EY Technology
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.
Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
The opportunity
We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer to join our Security Technology Services Engineering team. In this role you will help design and deliver organization-wide secure development capabilities, including standardized CI/CD patterns that embed security tooling and quality gates, so teams can build and ship securely at scale. You will also contribute to cloud security engineering across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including CNAPP platforms such as Wiz, and support selective use of AI to strengthen security workflows and guide secure AI adoption. You will work alongside like-minded engineers, partner across technology and security teams, and help make security automated, consistent, and easier for developers to adopt.
Your key Responsibilities
As an individual contributor, you’ll bring your engineering expertise into efforts which introduce new technologies and upgrade existing ones. Active project participation in new or integrated technologies as the Subject Matter Expert for the Information Security use cases pertaining to Cloud Security technology. You will be responsible for the design, engineering, implementation, and early life cycle support of systems and services within our EY multi-cloud environments. You will work closely with Teams across EY such as: Security Architects, Service Delivery, Security Operations, and Cyber Defense for the enablement of security solutions and services. You will also provide consulting services to other teams and act as a level four contact for operational issues.
Provide technical oversight of Information Security technologies that fall under the team’s responsibilities, confirming they are operating within agreed service levels and at peak possible performance
Represent the team in specific Project activities, including Leading projects and managing the activity of others towards successful completion.
Engineer security solutions and services following all relevant EY standards and practices for On-Premises, Hybrid and Cloud-Based environments .
Lead the design, implementation, testing of security solutions and services for a large or more complex project to its completion which includes production support and documentation.
Take accountability for the design, delivery, and maintenance of new and existing security solutions or services, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards.
Apply modern standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, security standards, design standards, to security solutions and services as appropriate.
Improve existing security solutions and services in use by partnering with Security Architecture, Service Owners, and Security Operations. Drives automation and innovation across the security solutions supported.
Work in a diverse, global environment and build strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically, and culturally dispersed organization.
Be flexible to work out of regular office hours to accommodate the team and organizational calls and meetings. Weekend or late-night work may occur during project and early life cycle support phases.
No direct supervision responsibilities though technical leadership required within assigned projects.
Articulate technology issues/concerns that may emerge at any level of the technical stack, and from any component across the ecosystem, to senior business and technology leaders .
Skills and attributes for success
We are interested in engineers who blend DevOps/automation and security in large enterprise environments; people who improve developer experience by making security standardized and easy to adopt, while also applying strong cloud security judgment across platforms and tooling. Success in this role means collaborating with technical teams, stakeholders, and internal customers to deliver practical, scalable solutions.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Hands-on experience designing or operating DevSecOps / secure CI/CD pipelines that integrate security controls and gate checks (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, or equivalent).
Practical experience with several application and software supply-chain security capabilities, such as SAST, SCA/OSS scanning, secrets scanning, DAST, and container image scanning, and helping teams adopt them through standards, templates, or reusable patterns.
Hands-on experience with cloud security across one or more major providers ( Azure, AWS, GCP ), with the ability to apply security controls, automation, and good architectural judgment in cloud environments (Azure experience strongly preferred).
Experience with CNAPP / CSPM / CWPP / KSPM capabilities, ideally including Wiz (or comparable platforms), and using findings to drive remediation and secure-by-default patterns.
Proficiency in scripting and automation with PowerShell, Bash, Python , or similar languages.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent).
4+ years of experience in security, DevOps/platform engineering, or software delivery with a strong security focus.
Proven track record of working with a team as well as managing projects and initiatives.
Proficiency with change control management processes.
The ability and desire to train and mentor staff in technical process and best practices.
Extensive experience working in large, global, and virtual environments.
Strong English language skills, both written and verbal.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Experience building reusable pipeline templates / golden paths that make secure development the default for many teams.
Experience introducing or operationalizing AI tooling to improve security engineering workflows, and/or familiarity with secure use of AI/LLM capabilities in an enterprise context.
Hands-on experience with containers and Kubernetes security as it intersects delivery pipelines and runtime posture (e.g., AKS/EKS/GKE, image scanning, admission/policy controls).
Experience with policy-as-code or cloud guardrails (e.g., Azure Policy, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent).
Experience with automation and workflow orchestration services (e.g., Logic Apps/Power Automate, n8n, or similar).
Experience or awareness of observability and operational telemetry platforms (e.g., Azure Log Analytics, Grafana, or equivalent).
Relevant certifications in cloud administration, engineering, or security (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP).
Security certifications such as GSEC, CISSP, or equivalents from ISC2 or GIAC.
Project management experience and familiarity with service introduction and readiness processes.
Familiarity with hybrid cloud architectures and connectivity solutions (e.g., Azure Arc, Azure ExpressRoute, AWS Direct Connect).
What we look for
This role is perfect for you, if you have excellent problem solving, decision making and communication skills.
We are looking for people who are comfortable working with culturally diverse on/offshore team members, able to react appropriately during stressful and ambiguous situations, and drive efforts to successful and timely completion.
What we offer:
As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

Active project participation in new or integrated technologies as the Subject Matter Expert for the Information Security use cases pertaining to Cloud Security technology.
